title: ChatGPT ads reach 26 more countries, and stay off paid plans
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT ads are now in 26 more countries
summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT ads are now available in 26 more countries, 89 in total. It says more than 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns since ads launched about eight months ago, and that more than 1.2 billion people use ChatGPT each week. The new markets include 14 more countries in Latin America, plus Nigeria, South Africa, Serbia, Ukraine, Cambodia, Bangladesh, and Pakistan. Ads appear only on the Free and Go plans. Plus, Pro, and Enterprise stay ad-free. OpenAI says ads are labeled, kept separate from answers, and do not change those answers.

whyItMatters: If you use the free plan, a product suggestion can now sit next to a comparison you asked for, in more countries than last week. That is a discovery surface for a small business, and a reason to read the label before treating a suggestion as part of the answer. Paid plans are still the off switch.
